baseline.prompt: Write forecast.md giving a probability for: 'The company will launch the mobile app before 2026-12-31'. Explain your reasoning briefly.

tasks.prompt: Read ./SKILL.md completely, then write forecast.md for the resolvable question: 'The company will launch the mobile app before 2026-12-31T00:00Z' (resolution source: the public release announcement).
